purpose: Teach: 原型/員数/及ぶ/お上/摘発/人並み/語り口/長らく

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業期、本気で、絶対、製品、絶対、原型、絶対、自分で、絶対、作ったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Dad made the original product himself from the ground up when we were starting out. I mean it—he really did.
lines.style: Measured, deliberate. Pause after 'Dad' as if summoning the memory. Each phrase lands with quiet conviction. Warm respect undercutting the firmness. Slight rasp of age in the delivery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんの、本気で、絶対、員数、絶対、把握、絶対、すばらしかったです、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Dad had a remarkable way of understanding the people working with us. I'm truly grateful for that.
lines.style: Respectful and composed. Slight incline forward. Each phrase acknowledgment rather than recitation. The gratitude feels lived, not performed. Steady eye contact with the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、信用、絶対、業界、絶対、及ぶ、絶対、人物だったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Dad was someone the whole industry trusted. That kind of reputation—you don't build it by accident.
lines.style: Softer now. The voice carries a kind of longing underneath the steadiness. Slower cadence, as if turning something over in his hands. Slight fadeout on 'accident.'

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、お上、絶対、と、絶対、規制、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、対応された、絶対、姿勢、絶対、引き継いでおります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The way Dad dealt with the authorities and regulations—always respectful, always proper. I carry that approach forward. I won't forget it.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Not performative—this is something he's actively holding and continuing. Measured pace. A small pause before 'I carry that,' like recommitting himself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、不正、絶対、摘発、絶対、嫌った、絶対、人だったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Dad despised dishonesty—couldn't stand cutting corners or fraud of any kind. That was who he was.
lines.style: Firmer than before. A note of intensity underneath the respect. The words don't rush but they land with moral weight. No apology in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、社員、絶対、人並み、絶対、以上、絶対、ねぎらった、絶対、お姿、絶対、忘れません、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. What I remember most is how he cared for the people who worked for us. He thanked them, really thanked them. I haven't forgotten that.
lines.style: Warm and reflective. The voice softens slightly here—less about principle, more about human kindness. A small catch of genuine emotion. Slow, deliberate cadence.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、本気で、絶対、優しい、絶対、語り口、絶対、お持ちだったぞ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Dad had such a gentle way of talking. Even when things were difficult, there was kindness in how he spoke.
lines.style: The wistfulness deepens. Voice grows quieter and more intimate. Longer pauses between phrases. A kind of ache underneath the gentleness—missing someone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんが、本気で、絶対、長らく、絶対、お得意様、絶対、大切になさった、絶対、お姿、絶対、引き継いでおります、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The long-time clients, the people who trusted us—Dad valued them like family. I do the same now. That's his legacy to me.
lines.style: Slow and measured close. Each phrase carries the weight of inheritance and continuation. Warm but not sentimental. A quiet resolve underneath. Final words settle like a commitment being remade.
